takes.situation: Plates up her arm, she takes the Fixer for the Bureau; the wrong guess collapses.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Mind the plates. If it's the Bureau loan, my card's stamped.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Not the Bureau. It's you and Okafor, on the Office door.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Table six is waiting. Who told you that?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: We can tell the Office about your affair. Smile, people can see.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: They'd have him off that door. What do you want from me?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: When I telephone, call him off it to you. About a minute.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: I'll call him, because you've scared me. I won't forget your face.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: No, you won't. You could describe it to anyone who asks.

learned: Inez knows the Fixer's face now.

takes.situation: The ask comes first, as if a favour; she denies Okafor until the threat lands.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Terrace is full, and I've two trays up. Try the counter.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: I'll telephone. You call Okafor off the Office door for a minute.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: I don't know any Okafor. Did someone at my tables say that?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: We saw you look at his door. Lower your voice, please.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: I've got the Bureau on my card already. Isn't that enough?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Sorry, no. One note by tube tells the Office of your affair.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Don't send it. He comes to me, a minute, and that's all?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: That's all. You'll hate me, and you could describe me if asked.

learned: Inez knows the Fixer's face now.

takes.situation: She tries to buy her way out with her loan money; the Fixer refuses it.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Mind my envelope, that's for my Bureau loan. Are you waiting?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Okafor, in a way. The Office hasn't heard about your affair yet.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Take it, it's all I've got. Just not the Office, please.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Keep it. When we telephone, you call Okafor off the door.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Off the door, in front of everyone? To do what?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: To stand at your side about a minute. That's all you do.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: You've frightened me, so I'll do it. Now turn to the light.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Go on, look. You could describe me to anyone who asks.

learned: Inez knows the Fixer's face now.
